fusions.name: Inevitable Blow
fusions.desc: A slow, heavy blow that deals 40 damage, always lands as a critical hit, and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Drawn-Out Lob
fusions.desc: Lobs a weight that deals 4 damage and has a 50% chance to leave the target [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Mend
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 20 seconds.

fusions.name: Unhurried Bulk
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 12%. It also regenerates 0.8 health a second, permanently.
